translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, and shoulder pain.
translation.usage: Apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: infants under 30 months of age; the area around the eyes; mucous membranes; eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to this medicine or to cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; children. This medicine is for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. This medicine is for external use only. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching. Store at room temperature, protected from light. Keep out of reach of children.
